integrity: Sharp norm and all equality cases follow from a general signed-measure reduction, exact rational single-arc residual formula, and Hilbert rigidity; finite tests are supplemental, and independent review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional real circular BV with full circumference variation; one-sided uniform averaging over 0<a<=1; normalized Lebesgue L2. No claim for centered windows, complex measures, arbitrary smoothing kernels or Lp. Closely related 2009 Steklov L2 source unavailable in full text; historical priority not certified.
title: A flat-to-rigid transition and nonmonotone bandwidth law for circular boxcar smoothing
